title: BTS ARIRANG World Tour 2026: Here’s Where to Buy Affordable Last-Minute Tickets Online
summary: The supergroup returns to the United States with more tour dates starting on Saturday (Aug. 1).
contentText:
All products and services featured are independently chosen by editors. However, Billboard may receive a commission on orders placed through its retail links, and the retailer may receive certain auditable data for accounting purposes.

South Korean supergroup BTS, which includes RM, Jin, SUGA, j-hope, Jimin, V and Jungkook, is back on the road in the United States after a magnificent performance during the FIFA World Cup Final Halftime Show . The ARIRANG World Tour is scheduled to return in the U.S. after the group’s European leg on Saturday (Aug. 1) at MetLife Stadium in New Jersey.

The U.S. leg of the tour ends on Sunday (Sept. 6) at SoFi Stadium in Inglewood, California, before the group travels to South America, Southeast Asia and Australia for the rest of 2026 and into the beginning of 2027.

SHOP BTS Tour Tickets at Ticketmaster

Tickets to the tour first went on sale through Live Nation and Ticketmaster , while the retailer’s Face Value Exchange program is an option for fans to resell tickets.

However, many of the dates have either sold out, or are very close to selling out, so one of the best ways to find last-minute BTS tickets online is through third-party sites, including StubHub , SeatGeek , Vivid Seats , TicketNetwork , Gametime , Event Tickets Center and others. All online retailers guarantee authentic tickets in time for your concert. Prices may be above or below face value at times.

The boy group’s 2026 album, titled ARIRANG, is out now, and the boy band is going on tour to support it. The hype is so real that the North American and European legs of the world tour have already sold out within hours of when tickets went on sale, which really reflects ARMY’s hardcore devotion to BTS. Now fans are able to listen to tracks, such as “Swim,” “Body to Body” and “Alien” live, as well as the supergroup’s older discography.

Think of it this way. This is the first album BTS has released since they all took time off to fulfill the mandatory military service in South Korea, a service that takes up to 18 to 21 months. The last time the group went on tour in the U.S. was back during the “Permission to Dance on Stage” residency, which wrapped up in Las Vegas, Nevada, in April 2022. It’s safe to say that the lengthy hiatus and lack of music have left fans craving more of the BTS boys.
